name: Asia Scoring
text: Presence 3, Domination 7, Control 9. +1 VP per controlled Battleground; +1 VP per controlled country adjacent to enemy superpower. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Europe Scoring
text: Presence 3, Domination 7, Control = Automatic Victory. +1 VP per controlled Battleground; +1 VP per controlled country adjacent to enemy superpower. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Middle East Scoring
text: Presence 3, Domination 5, Control 7. +1 VP per controlled Battleground. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Duck and Cover
text: Degrade DEFCON by 1. The US receives VP equal to 5 minus the current DEFCON level.

name: Five Year Plan
text: The USSR must randomly discard a card. If it has a US event, the event occurs immediately. A USSR or both-player event is discarded without effect.

name: The China Card
text: +1 Ops when all points are used in Asia. Pass to opponent face down after play. +1 VP for the holder at the end of Turn 10. Cancels Formosan Resolution if played by the US.

name: Socialist Governments
text: Unplayable as an event if The Iron Lady is in effect. Remove a total of 3 US Influence from Western Europe, no more than 2 per country.

name: Fidel
text: Remove all US Influence in Cuba. USSR gains sufficient Influence in Cuba for Control.

name: Vietnam Revolts
text: Add 2 USSR Influence in Vietnam. For the rest of the turn the USSR adds 1 Op to any card that uses all its points in Southeast Asia.

name: Blockade
text: Unless the US immediately discards a card with 3 or more Ops, remove all US Influence from West Germany.

name: Korean War
text: North Korea invades South Korea. Roll a die, -1 per US-controlled country adjacent to South Korea. USSR wins on 4-6: +2 VP and replaces all US Influence in South Korea. USSR adds 2 to Military Ops.

name: Romanian Abdication
text: Remove all US Influence in Romania. USSR gains sufficient Influence in Romania for Control.

name: Arab-Israeli War
text: Roll a die, -1 if the US controls Israel and -1 per US-controlled country adjacent to Israel. USSR wins on 4-6: +2 VP and replaces all US Influence in Israel. USSR adds 2 to Military Ops. Not playable after Camp David Accords.

name: COMECON
text: Add 1 USSR Influence in each of four non-US-controlled countries of Eastern Europe.

name: Nasser
text: Add 2 USSR Influence in Egypt. Remove half (rounded up) of the US Influence in Egypt.

name: Warsaw Pact Formed
text: Remove all US Influence from four countries in Eastern Europe, OR add 5 USSR Influence in Eastern Europe (max 2 per country). Allows NATO to be played as an event.

name: De Gaulle Leads France
text: Remove 2 US Influence in France, add 1 USSR Influence. Cancels NATO for France.

name: Captured Nazi Scientist
text: Advance the player's Space Race marker one box.

name: Truman Doctrine
text: Remove all USSR Influence in one uncontrolled country in Europe.

name: Olympic Games
text: Opponent participates or boycotts. Participate: both roll, sponsor +2, high roll gains 2 VP (reroll ties). Boycott: degrade DEFCON 1 and the sponsor conducts Operations as if a 4 Ops card.

name: NATO
text: Play after Marshall Plan or Warsaw Pact. USSR may no longer Coup or Realign in US-controlled countries in Europe, and they cannot be attacked by Brush War.

name: Independent Reds
text: Add US Influence in Yugoslavia, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary or Czechoslovakia to equal the USSR Influence there.

name: Marshall Plan
text: Allows play of NATO. Add 1 US Influence in each of seven non-USSR-controlled Western European countries.

name: Indo-Pakistani War
text: India or Pakistan invades the other. Roll a die, -1 per opponent-controlled country adjacent to the target. Win on 4-6: +2 VP and replace the opponent's Influence in the target. Player adds 2 to Military Ops.

name: Containment
text: All further Operations cards played by the US this turn add 1 to their value (max 4).

name: CIA Created
text: USSR reveals hand this turn. Then the US conducts Operations as if a 1 Op card.

name: US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact
text: US gains sufficient Influence in Japan for Control. USSR may no longer Coup or Realign in Japan.

name: Suez Crisis
text: Remove a total of 4 US Influence from France, the UK and Israel, no more than 2 per country.

name: East European Unrest
text: Early/Mid War: remove 1 USSR Influence from three countries in Eastern Europe. Late War: remove 2 from each of three.

name: Decolonization
text: Add 1 USSR Influence in each of four African and/or Southeast Asian countries.

name: Red Scare/Purge
text: All further Operations cards played by your opponent this turn are -1 (min 1).

name: UN Intervention
text: Play with a card containing your opponent's event. The event is cancelled; use that card's Ops. Not in the Headline Phase.

name: De-Stalinization
text: USSR may relocate up to 4 Influence to non-US-controlled countries, no more than 2 per country.

name: Nuclear Test Ban
text: Player earns VP equal to DEFCON minus 2, then improve DEFCON two levels.

name: Formosan Resolution
text: Taiwan is a Battleground for Asia scoring/Final Scoring if the US controls it. Discarded after the US plays The China Card.

name: Defectors
text: Play in the Headline Phase to cancel the USSR Headline event (even a scoring card). If played by the USSR in an action round, US gains 1 VP (unless used for the Space Race).

name: The Cambridge Five
text: US exposes scoring cards in hand. USSR may add 1 Influence to a single Region named on one of them. Not playable as an event in Late War.

name: Special Relationship
text: If US controls UK and NATO is not in effect: +1 US Influence in a country adjacent to the UK. If NATO is in effect: +2 US Influence in any Western European country and +2 VP.

name: NORAD
text: If the US controls Canada, the US may add 1 Influence to a country with US Influence at the end of any Action Round in which DEFCON moved to 2. Cancelled by Quagmire.

name: Brush War
text: Attack a country with stability 1 or 2. Roll a die, -1 per adjacent enemy-controlled country. Success on 3-6: +1 VP and replace the opponent's Influence. Player adds 3 to Military Ops.

name: Central America Scoring
text: Presence 1, Domination 3, Control 5. +1 VP per controlled Battleground; +1 VP per controlled country adjacent to enemy superpower. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Southeast Asia Scoring
text: 1 VP each for Control of Burma, Laos/Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines. 2 VP for Thailand. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Arms Race
text: If the phasing player has more Military Ops: 1 VP, or 3 VP if they have also met the required Military Ops.

name: Cuban Missile Crisis
text: Set DEFCON to 2. Any opponent Coup this turn causes nuclear war (opponent loses). Cancelled if USSR removes 2 Influence from Cuba, or US removes 2 from West Germany or Turkey.

name: Nuclear Subs
text: US Coups in Battlegrounds do not degrade DEFCON for the rest of the turn.

name: Quagmire
text: Each US action round, the US must discard a 2+ Ops card and roll 1-4 to cancel. If no such cards, may only play scoring cards. Cancels NORAD.

name: SALT Negotiations
text: Improve DEFCON two levels. Coups are -1 for both players for the rest of the turn. Player may reclaim one non-scoring card from the discard pile.

name: Bear Trap
text: Each USSR action round, the USSR must discard a 2+ Ops card and roll 1-4 to cancel. If no such cards, may only play scoring cards.

name: Summit
text: Both roll, +1 per Region Dominated or Controlled. High roller gains 2 VP and may move DEFCON one level either way. Ties: no effect.

name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying
text: Set DEFCON to any level (1-5). Counts as 5 Military Ops.

name: Junta
text: Place 2 Influence in one Central or South American country. Then you may make a free Coup or Realignment in one of these regions using this card's Ops.

name: Kitchen Debates
text: If the US controls more Battlegrounds than the USSR, gain 2 VP.

name: Missile Envy
text: Exchange this card for your opponent's highest-Ops card. If it has your or both events, it occurs now; if the opponent's event, use its Ops. Opponent must use Missile Envy for Ops on their next action round.

name: We Will Bury You
text: Degrade DEFCON one level. Unless UN Intervention is played as an event on the US's next action round, USSR gains 3 VP.

name: Brezhnev Doctrine
text: All further Operations cards played by the USSR this turn add 1 to their value (max 4).

name: Portuguese Empire Crumbles
text: Add 2 USSR Influence in both SE African States and Angola.

name: South African Unrest
text: USSR adds 2 Influence in South Africa, or 1 in South Africa and 2 in countries adjacent to South Africa.

name: Allende
text: USSR receives 2 Influence in Chile.

name: Willy Brandt
text: USSR gains 1 VP and 1 Influence in West Germany. Cancels NATO for West Germany. Unplayable/cancelled by Tear Down This Wall.

name: Muslim Revolution
text: Remove all US Influence in two of: Sudan, Iran, Iraq, Egypt, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Jordan. Not playable after AWACS Sale to Saudis.

name: ABM Treaty
text: Improve DEFCON one level. Then conduct Operations as if a 4 Ops card.

name: Cultural Revolution
text: If the US has The China Card, the USSR claims it face up. If the USSR already has it, USSR gains 1 VP.

name: Flower Power
text: USSR gains 2 VP for every later US-played War card (event or Ops, not Space Race). Prevented/cancelled by An Evil Empire.

name: U2 Incident
text: USSR gains 1 VP. If UN Intervention is played as an event later this turn, USSR gains 1 more VP.

name: OPEC
text: USSR gains 1 VP for each controlled: Egypt, Iran, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Gulf States, Venezuela. Unplayable if North Sea Oil is in effect.

name: Lone Gunman
text: US reveals hand. Then the USSR conducts Operations as if a 1 Op card.

name: Colonial Rear Guards
text: Add 1 US Influence in each of four African and/or Southeast Asian countries.

name: Panama Canal Returned
text: Add 1 US Influence in Panama, Costa Rica and Venezuela.

name: Camp David Accords
text: US gains 1 VP and 1 Influence in Israel, Jordan and Egypt. Arab-Israeli War no longer playable.

name: Puppet Governments
text: US adds 1 Influence in three countries with no Influence from either power.

name: Grain Sales to Soviets
text: Randomly take a card from the USSR hand. Play it or return it. If returned (or no cards), use this card's Ops.

name: John Paul II Elected Pope
text: Remove 2 USSR Influence in Poland, then add 1 US Influence. Allows play of Solidarity.

name: Latin American Death Squads
text: This turn your Coups in Central/South America are +1, your opponent's are -1.

name: OAS Founded
text: Add 2 US Influence in Central and/or South America.

name: Nixon Plays the China Card
text: If the US has The China Card, gain 2 VP. Otherwise the US receives it now, face down.

name: Sadat Expels Soviets
text: Remove all USSR Influence in Egypt and add 1 US Influence.

name: Shuttle Diplomacy
text: At the next Middle East or Asia scoring, subtract one Battleground from the USSR, then discard. Not for Final Scoring.

name: The Voice of America
text: Remove 4 USSR Influence from non-European countries, no more than 2 per country.

name: Liberation Theology
text: Add 3 USSR Influence in Central America, no more than 2 per country.

name: Ussuri River Skirmish
text: If the USSR has The China Card, the US claims it face up. If the US already has it, add 4 US Influence in Asia (max 2 per country).

name: Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You
text: US may discard any number of cards (decide before drawing) and draw replacements.

name: Alliance for Progress
text: US gains 1 VP per US-controlled Battleground in Central and South America.

name: Africa Scoring
text: Presence 1, Domination 4, Control 6. +1 VP per controlled Battleground. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: One Small Step
text: If behind on the Space Race, move forward two boxes, gaining VP for the second box only.

name: South America Scoring
text: Presence 2, Domination 5, Control 6. +1 VP per controlled Battleground. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Che
text: USSR may Coup a non-Battleground in Central America, South America or Africa using this card's Ops. If it removes US Influence, a second Coup against a different target.

name: Our Man in Tehran
text: If the US controls a Middle East country, draw the top 5 cards, discard any (revealed to USSR) without events, return the rest and reshuffle.

name: Iranian Hostage Crisis
text: Remove all US Influence in Iran. Add 2 USSR Influence in Iran. Doubles Terrorism against the US.

name: The Iron Lady
text: US gains 1 VP. Add 1 USSR Influence to Argentina. Remove all USSR Influence from the UK. Socialist Governments no longer playable.

name: Reagan Bombs Libya
text: US gains 1 VP for every 2 USSR Influence in Libya.

name: Star Wars
text: If the US is ahead on the Space Race, choose a non-scoring card from the discard pile; its event occurs immediately.

name: North Sea Oil
text: OPEC no longer playable. US may play 8 action rounds this turn.

name: The Reformer
text: Add 4 USSR Influence in Europe (max 2 per country), or 6 if the USSR leads in VP. USSR may no longer Coup in Europe. Improves Glasnost.

name: Marine Barracks Bombing
text: Remove all US Influence in Lebanon plus 2 more US Influence anywhere in the Middle East.

name: Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007
text: Degrade DEFCON one level. US gains 2 VP. If the US controls South Korea, the US may place Influence or Realign as if a 4 Ops card.

name: Glasnost
text: USSR gains 2 VP. Improve DEFCON one level. If The Reformer is in effect, the USSR may place Influence or Realign as if a 4 Ops card.

name: Ortega Elected in Nicaragua
text: Remove all US Influence from Nicaragua. Then the USSR may make a free Coup (with this card's Ops) in a country adjacent to Nicaragua.

name: Terrorism
text: Opponent randomly discards one card (two if the USSR plays it on the US while Iranian Hostage Crisis is in effect). Events on discards do not occur.

name: Iran-Contra Scandal
text: All US Realignment rolls are -1 for the rest of the turn.

name: Chernobyl
text: The US designates a Region. For the rest of the turn the USSR may not place Influence there with Operations.

name: Latin American Debt Crisis
text: Unless the US immediately discards a 3+ Ops card, double the USSR Influence in two South American countries.

name: Tear Down This Wall
text: Cancels/prevents Willy Brandt. Add 3 US Influence in East Germany. Then the US may make a free Coup or Realignments in Europe using this card's Ops.

name: An Evil Empire
text: Cancels/prevents Flower Power. US gains 1 VP.

name: Aldrich Ames Remix
text: US exposes their hand for the rest of the turn. USSR chooses one card from it to discard.

name: Pershing II Deployed
text: USSR gains 1 VP. Remove 1 US Influence from up to three countries in Western Europe.

name: Wargames
text: If DEFCON is 2, you may immediately end the game (no Final Scoring) after giving your opponent 6 VP.

name: Solidarity
text: Playable as an event only if John Paul II Elected Pope is in effect. Add 3 US Influence in Poland.

name: Iran-Iraq War
text: Iran or Iraq invades the other. Roll a die, -1 per opponent-controlled country adjacent to the target. Win on 4-6: +2 VP and replace the opponent's Influence. Player adds 2 to Military Ops.

name: Samantha and Yuri
text: USSR receives 1 VP for each US Coup attempt for the rest of the turn.

name: AWACS Sale to Saudis
text: US receives 2 Influence in Saudi Arabia. Muslim Revolution may no longer be played as an event.
